hero.text: Learn Nishchay topic by topic, from installation to your first route and beyond.

paths.title: Choose where to start
paths.subTitle: Pick the path that matches what you want to do first.

install.title: Install
install.text: Set up Nishchay on Linux, macOS or Windows.

requests.title: Handle requests
requests.text: Create controllers and routes that respond to requests.

database.title: Work with databases
database.text: Map entities to tables and build queries.

configuration.title: Configure your app
configuration.text: Learn what each application setting does.

session.title: Sessions
session.text: Keep data across requests in files, a database or a cache.

webService.title: Web services
webService.text: Build JSON or XML services with token-based access.

console.title: Console commands
console.text: Generate code, inspect your app and run cron jobs.

maintenance.title: Maintenance modes
maintenance.text: Pause your app by browser, time range or callback.

forms.title: Forms and validation
forms.text: Build forms and validate what users submit.

events.title: Events
events.text: Run code before or after entity changes.

cache.title: Caching
cache.text: Serve repeated data from cache instead of the database.

localization.title: Localization
localization.text: Serve your application in more than one language.

docs.title: Documentation
docs.text: Read each topic one by one, with an estimated reading time for every page.

progress.title: Reading progress
progress.text: When you are signed in, the Learning Center tracks the time you spend on each topic. See your progress in your profile.

notes.title: Private notes
notes.text: Add notes to any topic to help you concentrate and revise later. Only you can see them.

support.title: Need a hand?
support.subTitle: Ask questions and see what other developers are building.

discord.title: Discord
discord.text: Chat by voice, video or text. Join to ask your questions and see what other developers are working on.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.text: Prefer direct help? Contact us on WhatsApp for any kind of help.
